definition.unit: Each discovered regression entry in scripts/regression-coverage-manifest.json, scanning the entry source plus its folded contract modules as one text.
definition.historicalContentPinners: Entries whose source references ROADMAP-ARCHIVE.md or CHANGELOG.md. Release acceptance requires zero by 0.33.33.32; checkpoints 0.33.33.29-0.33.33.32 own the stripping.
definition.planningDocumentReaders: Entries whose source references ROADMAP.md, ROADMAP-ARCHIVE.md, or CHANGELOG.md. The release-wide fewer-than-40 target is measured against this list after stripping.
definition.exclusions: release.historical-evidence-retirement (the scanning owner) and non-discovered runner/ceremony tooling are excluded by construction. Cursor-floor callers using scripts/lib/roadmap-cursor.mjs without naming a planning document are excluded by construction because the scan matches document names, not helper imports.
definition.relationToAudit: The 2026-08-17 audit counted 39 discovered entries asserting on CHANGELOG content and 75 asserting on any planning document; this mention-based scan is intentionally broader (59/100 at baseline) so ceremony-string references also shrink or are consciously retained.
definition.maintenance: Shrink-only. Removing a pin requires deleting its id here in the same change; adding any id is prohibited and fails release.historical-evidence-retirement.
definition.reviewedDispositions: Reviewed release/docs-area entries recorded at checkpoint 0.33.33.29. Each was inspected and found to reference planning-document filenames as ceremony path strings, synthetic fixture content, or detector patterns rather than as historical product evidence, so each asserts a current live contract and is consciously retained under the release-wide acceptance. Stripping remains owned by later checkpoints for their own areas.

reviewedDispositions.legacy.bump.version: Retained: writes a synthetic CHANGELOG.md into a temporary directory as version-bump fixture input; never reads repository history.
reviewedDispositions.release.changed-regression-auto-run: Retained: lists CHANGELOG.md and ROADMAP.md as ceremony path strings to assert current changed-path routing behavior.
reviewedDispositions.release.current-static-contracts: Retained: owns the archived-evidence detector itself. It matches the pattern against a string literal to prove the detector fires, then asserts every other release-gate owner does not match it. Removing these strings would delete the enforcement mechanism.
reviewedDispositions.release.developer-verification-throughpu: Retained: uses ceremony path strings to assert current slice routing, checkpoint trailer validation, and the deferred release-identity rules.
reviewedDispositions.release.github-only-docs-workflow-routin: Retained: lists release bookkeeping paths to assert the current GitHub-only documentation classifier.
reviewedDispositions.release.regression-routing-commands: Retained: passes ceremony paths to assert current routing command selection.
reviewedDispositions.release.runtime-artifact-boundary: Retained: lists ceremony paths in the runtime-artifact exclusion boundary it asserts.
